description:
No spec subject (candidates: specled.append_only when picked up). Severity: Medium (calibrated down from spec auditor H1). From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. The self_authorized_weakening marker is emitted per (requirement, class) by the class-specific detectors; a requirement weakened via a path only one detector sees can surface differently depending on detector order. Keep-reason: unmade design decision — ticket q0q.2 simultaneously required uniform marker emission and forbade touching authorizing_decision/2, so a uniform-emission design (single choke point) needs its own decision + ADR. Concrete failure: a requirement weakened in class A while suppressed in class B can yield marker sets that depend on detector iteration order rather than a stated contract.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.append_only

DECISION-CLASS: yes. Deliverable is an ADR + spec amendment + code. Per operator ruling on
epic specled_-i4x, draft it fully and record completion normally — the orchestrator will NOT
merge it without human sign-off.

WHERE THE TICKET IS MISLOCATED (read before designing): analyze/4
(lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex:100-115) runs detectors in a FIXED order and sort_findings/1
the result, so output is not "detector iteration order" dependent in the naive sense. The
ticket's claim is directionally right but points at the wrong mechanism. The three REAL
defects are:

1. authorizing_decision/2 (lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex:698-722) is Enum.reduce_while over
   `decisions`, halting on the FIRST ADR whose affects contains the id with a weakening
   change_type. self_authorized_marker_if_new/6 (:673-686) then tests only THAT ADR against
   new_adr_ids. With two ADRs authorizing the same requirement — one pre-existing, one
   new-in-diff — whether a marker is emitted depends purely on the order of `decisions`.
2. self_auth_adr_by_req_id/1 (:665-669) is a Map.put fold: with two new self-authorizing ADRs
   affecting the same requirement, the LAST one wins and is named in the marker message.
3. detect_requirement_deleted has a SECOND emission path (:132-138) that emits the marker
   straight from self_auth_adr_by_req_id without consulting authorizing_decision/2, while
   detect_must_downgraded (:172), detect_scenario_regression (:225) and
   detect_negative_removed (:264) all route through authorizing_decision/2 ->
   self_authorized_marker_if_new/6. Two authorization contracts, one function apart.

WHY A SPEC AMENDMENT IS UNAVOIDABLE: specled.append_only.self_authorized_weakening
(.spec/specs/append_only.spec.md:135-146) states NO cardinality and NO tie-break rule. The
"one marker per (requirement, weakening class)" contract exists only as a test comment
(test/specled_ex/append_only_test.exs:1255-1271). Your ADR must state the cardinality and the
tie-break, and the spec statement must carry it.

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex
- .spec/specs/append_only.spec.md
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.*.md  (new ADR: uniform marker emission / authorization tie-break)
- test/specled_ex/append_only_test.exs
- test_support/append_only_fixtures.ex
- .spec/realization_hashes.json
- CHANGELOG.md

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check/severity.ex
- lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex
- lib/mix/tasks/**
- docs/**
- test/test_support/emitter_codes.ex

Out of Scope (intent):
- Do NOT add an ADR-status check to authorizing_decision/2. That is specled_-bg5.4, which is
  wired to depend on this ticket. Landing both blind produces two conflicting rewrites of the
  same function.
- Do NOT change :info severity or stdout rendering. That is specled_-bg5.5.
- Do NOT add a new append_only/* code — specled.decision.append_only_finding_budget_v2 governs
  the budget.
- Do NOT delete the self_auth_adr_by_req_id fast path without a stated replacement contract;
  it is what makes the superset-affects deletion scenario pass
  (.spec/specs/append_only.spec.md:344-354).

Verification:
  mix test test/specled_ex/append_only_test.exs
  mix test test/specled_ex/branch_check_test.exs
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix format --check-formatted
  mix spec.check --no-run-commands
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
No execute:false stub to flip — .spec/specs/append_only.spec.md has zero execute:false entries.
New scenarios attach to the existing tagged_tests block (.spec/specs/append_only.spec.md:400-417),
already execute:true; add to its covers: only if a new requirement id is minted.

Expected diff: ~120-200 lines across 5-6 files (ADR ~60, append_only.ex ~40-60, spec ~10, tests ~60).
